title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin holds at 63,940 dollars with fear entrenched at a 26 reading, yet hashrate sits firm at 915 EH/s, showing miners refuse to blink. Overnight price action stayed flat with minimal Asia session follow-through. 

Mempool backlog at 92,000 transactions keeps fees pinned at one sat per vbyte, signaling steady but unspectacular demand. 

Watch for any push above 64,000 dollars today; sustained fear readings often precede sharp relief moves if volume picks up into the US session.
